It had been nearly seven days since letters from
the prince stopped. The captain grew desperate,
we have not a clue and cannot return as is.
As the sun was setting, we set out to arrange camp
together with the main force. Suddenly, my vision
blurred, and while I was wondering about this sense
of vertigo, we found ourselves in a ridiculous world.
Headless apparitions and man-eating rabbits appeared
before our hapless squad. Our irresolute swords could
not stand up to their teeth, and one after another,
Officers vanished...where the hell is this place?
All I hear are the screams of my comrades the and growls
of monsters. Pain fills my head, I can feel something
inside was squashed. I know now, this must be Hell.
Unless we find an exit or set up a signal fire,
there's no hope of rescue. We'll all die here.
\c[2]If only I had a Master Key...
\c[2]There's no need to defeat all enemies.\c[0]

"For now, you'll be fine just walking around as

"Though if you take the red door, maybe you'll
drop dead? My condolences. The Cheshire Cat
never learned how to take responsibility, meow."
"Since you're so very miserable, you can have
a gift if you like, meow."
